blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Wealthy entrepreneurs in the Philippines trust artificial intelligence (AI) to manage investments, and many also expect the technology to affect jobs, HSBC reports. In its latest Global Entrepreneurial Wealth report, HSBC said net trust in AI to manage investments reached 83 percent among Philippine respondents. The figure matched levels in Qatar and Thailand. READ: Globe reaps P1.2B from AI outlays The survey covered 3,085 high-net-worth business owners worldwide, each with at least $2 million in investable assets.
